title: Mensuration: practice set 2
sourceNote: Original practice questions written for this group. None of them is a CAT previous-year question.
instructions: 6 questions, 12 minutes, CAT marking: +3 right, -1 wrong multiple choice, 0 for a wrong type-in answer.
Type-in answers take a number only: no %, ₹ or units. Use a decimal, not a fraction.

questions.text: The surface area of a sphere is 616 cm². What is its radius? Take π = 22/7.
A cylindrical bucket has radius 14 cm and height 30 cm. How many litres does it hold? Take π = 22/7.
A rectangular field is 60 m by 40 m. A path 5 m wide runs around the outside of it. What is the area of the path?
A solid hemisphere has radius 7 cm. What is its total surface area, in cm²? Take π = 22/7.
A cylindrical jar of radius 10 cm holds water. A solid metal ball of radius 6 cm is dropped in and sinks fully under the water. By how much does the water level rise?
A cone and a cylinder have the same base radius and the same height. The cylinder's volume is 540 cm³. What is the cone's volume, in cm³?
